translation.proposed_text_en: (7) Hidden reserves may be allocated to a tax-free reserve in the year of their disclosure, provided that no transfer is effected in the same business year.

clause_span.text: (7) Hidden reserves may be allocated to a tax-free reserve in the year of their disclosure, provided that no transfer is effected in the same business year

actions.text: be allocated to a tax-free reserve
actions.normalized: allocate hidden reserves to tax-free reserve

conditions.text: provided that no transfer is effected in the same business year
conditions.normalized: no transfer effected in same business year

constraints.text: in the year of their disclosure
constraints.normalized: in year hidden reserves are disclosed

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: Hidden reserves are the allocation object, and no taxpayer or accounting actor is expressly identified.

records.rationale_summary: Hidden reserves may be allocated to a tax-free reserve in their disclosure year only to the extent no transfer is effected during that same business year. The financial reserve is not treated as an actor.

translation.proposed_text_en: (8) The reserve (the tax-free amount) may be transferred in the following three financial years in accordance with the preceding provisions to the acquisition or production costs or the partial amounts of the acquisition or production costs within the meaning of Section 10(7), second sentence, of fixed assets.
issues: The preceding transfer provisions and Section 10(7), second sentence are not supplied.

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The preceding provisions and Section 10(7), second sentence are unavailable, so the incorporated transfer mechanics and cost categories cannot be expanded.
The transfer permission is passive and no taxpayer or accounting actor is explicit.

records.rationale_summary: The reserve may be transferred during the next three financial years under the preceding rules to the specified fixed-asset cost amounts. All visible timing, destination, and cross-reference limitations are retained without treating the reserve as an actor.

translation.proposed_text_en: The assets to which the reserves (tax-free amounts) may be transferred shall be determined by the assets in respect of which the hidden reserves were disclosed (paragraph 3).
issues: The substantive content of paragraph 3 is not supplied.

clause_span.text: The assets to which the reserves (tax-free amounts) may be transferred shall be determined by the assets in respect of which the hidden reserves were disclosed (paragraph 3)

constraints.text: by the assets in respect of which the hidden reserves were disclosed (paragraph 3)
constraints.normalized: according to assets whose hidden reserves were disclosed under paragraph 3

clause_span.text: The assets to which the reserves (tax-free amounts) may be transferred

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: Paragraph 3, which governs the relationship between disclosed hidden reserves and eligible transferee assets, is unavailable.
Both the determination rule and embedded transfer permission are passive; no responsible person is explicit.

records.rationale_summary: The main rule defines eligible transferee assets by reference to assets whose hidden reserves were disclosed under paragraph 3. The embedded phrase independently states that reserves may be transferred to those assets, so its express permission is retained as a second clause.

translation.proposed_text_en: (5) At the end of each financial year, bearer partial debentures of domestic debtors with a nominal amount of at least 50% of the provision amount shown in the balance sheet at the end of the preceding financial year must be present in the business assets (securities cover).

constraints.normalized: nominal amount at least 50 percent of prior year-end balance-sheet provision

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The securities-cover requirement does not expressly identify the person responsible for maintaining the debentures in business assets.

records.rationale_summary: At every financial year end, qualifying domestic-debtor bearer debentures with the specified minimum nominal amount must be present in business assets as securities cover. The debentures are regulated assets, not actors.

translation.proposed_text_en: (6) Taxpayers who determine their profit in accordance with Section 4(3) may apply in the tax return for an amount to be left tax-free for the notional severance pay claims existing at the end of the business year.
issues: The substantive content of Section 4(3) is not supplied.

translation.proposed_text_en: The benefit may only be claimed if the tax-exempt amounts are shown in a continuously maintained record submitted to the tax office together with the profit declaration for the relevant business year.
issues: The preceding provision defining 'The benefit' is not supplied.

translation.proposed_text_en: (7) Taxpayers who determine their profit pursuant to Section 4(1) or Section 5 may form pension provisions for written, legally binding, and irrevocable pension commitments.
issues: The substantive content of Section 4(1) and Section 5 is not supplied.
